name: Data Access Security Campaign Revocation Successful
description: Sent to a Data Access Security campaign's owner when its revocation processing finishes and every access item marked for removal was revoked successfully.
subject: Rejected permissions successfully revoked
body:
Campaign revocation successful

Dear $__recipient.name,

Automatic revocation was enabled on $campaign.campaignName. All access items that qualified for revocation were revoked successfully.

Campaign
$campaign.campaignName

Status
Revocation completed successfully

You can review the campaign revocation details here: View Campaign Details.

Thank you,
The SailPoint Team

This is an automatic message sent by Data Access Security. Please do not reply.
